text: DPE Summit 2027 · Feb 2–3, San Francisco DPE Summit Summit 2027 Speakers Coming soon Agenda Coming soon Past Summits 2025 2024 2023 2022 Virtual Events Lowdowns Showdowns Get Tickets DPE Summit 2027: Today’s SDLC is delivery-limited. An AI-native SDLC delivers at agent speed. DPE Summit is the conference where the teams who make delivery keep pace with agents compare notes and learn from each other. February 2–3, 2027 San Francisco, CA Get Tickets Submit a Talk 50 + speakers 30 + sessions 600 + attendees Brought to you by Fast, reliable builds and tests, so delivery keeps pace with your agents. At most companies, the teams that make delivery keep up with agents are small. The people who face similar problems at the same scale work elsewhere. DPE Summit puts all of these people in one room together. This year, DPE Summit is about the delivery side of the AI-native SDLC, and about the developers who steer the agents. As agents write more of the code, your work on builds, tests, CI, code reviews, evals, and keeping the toolchain healthy decides how fast that code reaches production. DPE Summit is not just another conference or tradeshow, it is an opportunity for people to join their peers, compare notes, and learn from some of the biggest companies in the world. Order Now DPE Summit 2027 Topics ← → Trusting what agents produce How you know an agent’s change is right when the agent also wrote the tests. Keeping verification fast and reliable at agent volume Builds and tests that hold up when agents raise the load by an order of magnitude. What builds and tests tell the agent The context that tells an agent whether its change caused a failure, and why. Review, merge, and release at agent scale Which agent changes still need a human reviewer, and how review and merge queues keep up with the rest. Evaluating the agents How you know a new model or harness made your agents better, not just different. Cost What a merged change costs in compute, tokens, and developer time, and how to bring it down. Engineers and agent fleets What limits one engineer steering agents, and what breaks as agents become a fleet. Running the delivery system like production SLOs for build times and flaky tests, and the delivery metrics that show whether agents help. Securing the toolchain Defending a toolchain that agents can reach, and tracing an attack to the software you shipped. Developer experience with agents What steering agents all day does to focus, trust, and how engineers learn. Who Should Attend DPE Summit is for building the systems that turn AI code generation into software delivery at agent speed, and for hearing from the teams furthest along. Can you deliver it faster? Generative AI is redefining how code gets written—faster, more frequently, and at greater scale. But your delivery pipeline wasn't built for this.
